exposure: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery, caesarean section, instrumental delivery)
cohort: 163 patients with severe haemophilia A (factor VIII <1%) aged between 2 weeks to 18 years
finding: The study found that assisted vaginal delivery was associated with a significant risk of ICH in newborns with severe haemophilia A compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery and caesarean section.
mod_finding: Assisted vaginal delivery was associated with a significant risk of ICH, in comparison to SVD and CS.
